definition: Computer systems that can learn, reason and solve problems like people.
exampleSentence: Our support chatbot uses AI to answer customer questions at night.

definition: The basic set of rules browsers and servers use to send web pages.
exampleSentence: When you open a website, your browser sends an HTTP request to the server.

definition: The language used to build the structure of web pages.
exampleSentence: Every web page you visit is built with HTML at its core.

definition: The language used to set colors, fonts and layout on web pages.
exampleSentence: The designer changed the CSS to make all the buttons red.

definition: A simple text format for storing and sending data.
exampleSentence: The server returns the list of users as a JSON file.

definition: A text format that uses tags to store and describe data.
exampleSentence: Older systems often exchange data with each other using XML documents.

definition: The language used to read and change data in databases.
exampleSentence: She wrote a short SQL command to find all orders from last week.

definition: A common style for designing web services that use HTTP.
exampleSentence: The mobile app gets its data from a REST service on our server.

definition: A set of tools and libraries for building apps for a platform.
exampleSentence: Download the Android SDK before you start building your first mobile app.

definition: A program where developers write, run and debug code.
exampleSentence: Visual Studio Code is a popular IDE among web developers today.

definition: A way to control a program by typing text commands.
exampleSentence: Many developers prefer the CLI because typing commands is faster than clicking.

definition: A way to use a program with windows, icons and buttons.
exampleSentence: Beginners usually find a GUI easier than typing commands in a terminal.

definition: Everything on the screen that a user sees and touches in an app.
exampleSentence: The new UI has bigger buttons and clearer menus for older users.

definition: How easy and pleasant a product feels to use.
exampleSentence: Good UX means people can finish their tasks without getting confused.

definition: Software you use online by subscription instead of installing it.
exampleSentence: Many companies now pay monthly for SaaS tools like email and chat.

definition: Automatic testing and releasing of code every time it changes.
exampleSentence: Our CI/CD pipeline runs all the tests before every new release.

definition: A way of working where developers and IT operations teams work closely together.
exampleSentence: The DevOps team makes sure new code reaches the servers safely.

definition: Testing a product to make sure it works well before release.
exampleSentence: The QA engineers found three bugs before the app was released.

definition: The simplest version of a product that can be tested with real users.
exampleSentence: The startup built a small MVP in two months to test its idea.

definition: A contract that says how reliable a service must be.
exampleSentence: Our SLA promises that the website will be online 99.9 percent of the time.

definition: A protocol that sends data reliably and in the correct order.
exampleSentence: Web browsers use TCP to make sure no part of a page is lost.

definition: A fast protocol that sends data without checking that it arrived.
exampleSentence: Online games often use UDP because speed matters more than perfect delivery.

definition: A protocol for moving files between computers over a network.
exampleSentence: In the past, web designers used FTP to upload files to their servers.

definition: A secure way to connect to and control another computer remotely.
exampleSentence: The administrator used SSH to log in to the server from home.

definition: An older technology that encrypts the connection between a browser and a website.
exampleSentence: Old tutorials often say SSL when they talk about secure websites.

definition: The modern technology that encrypts data sent over the internet.
exampleSentence: Banking websites use TLS to keep your card details private.

definition: An attack that floods a server with traffic from many computers until it stops working.
exampleSentence: A DDoS attack made the online shop unavailable for several hours.

definition: The protocol used to send email between servers.
exampleSentence: Our application connects to an SMTP server to send welcome emails.

definition: A company that sells internet access to homes and businesses.
exampleSentence: Call your ISP if the internet connection keeps dropping at home.

definition: A network that connects computers across cities or countries.
exampleSentence: The company uses a WAN to link its offices in three countries.

definition: Everyday devices that connect to the internet, like smart lights or watches.
exampleSentence: Smart thermostats and doorbells are common examples of IoT devices at home.

definition: A group of servers around the world that deliver web content quickly.
exampleSentence: Video sites use a CDN so viewers can stream movies without delays.

definition: A computer that runs as software inside another computer.
exampleSentence: Developers often test new software inside a VM to protect their main system.

definition: Technology that lets devices share data when they are very close together.
exampleSentence: You can pay at the store by holding your phone near the NFC reader.

definition: A code that works only once, often sent by text message.
exampleSentence: The bank sent an OTP to my phone to confirm the payment.

definition: A file format that keeps a document looking the same on every device.
exampleSentence: Please send your resume as a PDF so the layout does not change.

definition: An AI system trained on huge amounts of text to understand and write language.
exampleSentence: An LLM can summarize a long article in just a few seconds.

definition: The four basic actions an app performs on stored data.
exampleSentence: Most business apps are built around simple CRUD operations on a database.

definition: A style of programming that organizes code into objects with data and behavior.
exampleSentence: Java and Kotlin are languages that strongly support OOP concepts.

definition: Built-in software that starts a computer before the operating system loads.
exampleSentence: You can change the boot order by opening the BIOS when the computer starts.
